Triggers: UE is deregistered and needs to register to the network.
Network-initiated de-registration procedure completion by the UE.
Intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMMIDLE mode when registered for emergency bearer services in S1 mode.
Actions: UE initiates the initial registration procedure.
UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE handles EMM parameters if operating in single-registration mode after receiving a reject message.
Flow_of_execution: UE determines the need for initial registration
Causes: UE is not registered to the network.
Intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode when registered for emergency bearer services.
Expected_Outcomes: UE is successfully registered to the 5G network.
UE is able to access 5G services.
Error_Handling: UE handles EMM parameters if operating in single-registration mode after receiving a reject message.
UE stores the current TAI in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming.
Feedback_Loops: If registration is rejected, the UE may attempt registration on another PLMN or SNPN or over non-3GPP access.

metadata.Message_Types: REGISTRATION REQUEST, REGISTRATION ACCEPT, DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT
metadata.Excerpts: if the UE is registered for emergency bearer services in S1 mode the UE shall initiate the initial registration for emergency services.
